definition: Estimates Cislunar Comms Architecture readiness from component maturity.

title: Cislunar Comms Architecture Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Cislunar Comms Architecture operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Cislunar Comms Architecture installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 12278 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where gateway relays monitoring, architecture logistics redundancy, or lunar far side maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Cislunar Comms Architecture Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Cislunar Comms Architecture: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Cislunar Comms Architecture — comms for the Earth-Moon economic zone.

Phase 1 — Prove (gateway relays): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (architecture logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (lunar far side): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (commercial use): architecture hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cislunar-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
